title: An Apache Druid console is exposed
summary: The Apache Druid console answers here without signing in, which lets its data and queries be reached.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Apache Druid") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put the Druid console behind authentication and off the public internet.
